edit_summary.reason: Restructure the main engine reward to be a one-time bonus of +10 when the agent first descends below a distance threshold (distance < 0.5), instead of a per-step reward. This prevents the agent from collecting large rewards by slowly descending from high altitude. Increase the hovering penalty from -0.5 to -1.5 per step when |vy|<0.1 and distance is not decreasing, to make hovering more costly. Add a small progress bonus of +0.1 * (prev_distance - distance) when distance is decreasing, to provide continuous feedback for descending. Keep the success bonus at +200, crash penalty at -100, progress shaping at -1*distance -0.3*|vy|, fuel costs at -0.03*m_power -0.02*s_power, angle penalty at -0.05*|angle|, and descent reward at 0.5*(prev_vy - vy) when m_power>0 and vy<0. The expected behavior is that the agent will descend to the pad to collect the one-time main engine bonus and the success bonus, while the increased hovering penalty will discourage hovering.
preserved_design: descent reward: 0.5*(prev_vy - vy) when m_power>0 and vy<0
changed_design: main engine reward: changed from +2.0 per step when m_power>0 and distance decreasing to a one-time bonus of +10 when distance < 0.5 (first time only, tracked via self.main_engine_bonus_claimed)
hovering penalty: increased from -0.5 to -1.5 per step when |vy|<0.1 and distance >= previous_distance
added progress bonus: +0.1 * (prev_distance - distance) when distance < prev_distance, to provide continuous feedback for descending
rejected_patterns_avoided: Do not add a hard distance threshold to the main engine reward (failed pattern from iter_006 to iter_007). Instead, use a one-time bonus when close to pad.
Do not reduce the main engine reward below +0.5 per step (failed pattern from iter_007 to iter_008). Instead, replace per-step reward with one-time bonus.
Do not increase the hovering penalty above -2.0 per step (failed pattern from iter_006 to iter_007). Increased to -1.5, which is less than -2.0.
Do not add a reward for doing nothing (action 0).
Do not add a reward for orientation engines (actions 1 and 3) unless necessary.

expected_metric_changes.progress_mean: increase from -245.5 to > -200 (due to progress bonus)
